JwtSettings._SecretKey: The static API token, My_Encode-d (MyNewEncDec). The portal sends the decoded token as 'Authorization: Bearer ...' (API_MASTER.Api_Authorization / MasterApiSettings:Api_Authorization hold the same encoded text). Change it for production.

Cors._AllowBlazorApp: Browser origins allowed to call the API (QPS policy AllowBlazorApp). The portal calls the API from its server, so it needs no entry; Swagger runs on the API's own origin.

ApiMaster._BaseUrl: Base URL of this API written into API_MASTER when the API creates the schema (SqlServerCreateSchema), and used for the API list with PostgreSQL storage.

ConnectionStrings._DefaultConnection: SQL Server (PoGovSettings:Storage = sqlserver). With a SQL login: Server=<host>;Database=POGovernance;User Id=vmm_app;Password=<My_Encode(password)>;TrustServerCertificate=True; - the password is decoded with MyNewEncDec when PoGovSettings:EncryptedDbPassword is true (see database/sqlserver/README.md).
ConnectionStrings._PoGov: PostgreSQL (PoGovSettings:Storage = postgres): the v1.1.4 database, kept as fallback and as the migration source.

SapInterface._About: SAP R/3 interface /api/sap/v1 (spec v1.4) - see docs/sap/README.md. Basic-auth technical users are managed on the portal (/admin/sap).
SapInterface._Environment: PRODUCTION or TEST - returned by GET /ping.
SapInterface._EnforceIpAllowList: Optional IP check. false (default) = any caller with a valid SAP technical user + password is accepted. true = the caller must ALSO be in AllowedIps (then the list is required; empty = every call refused).
SapInterface._AllowedIps: Used only when EnforceIpAllowList is true: the SAP application servers' addresses or CIDR ranges, e.g. ["10.10.20.15", "10.10.21.0/24"].
SapInterface._TrustedProxies: Reverse proxies whose X-Forwarded-For is trusted (address / CIDR). X-Forwarded-For from anyone else is ignored.
SapInterface._OnlyOnPort: 0 = any port; 8443 = /api/sap answers only on the HTTPS listener of the Kestrel example below (404 elsewhere).
SapInterface._RulesVersion: rules_version of every decision; empty = R-P<planner parameters version>.
SapInterface._DecisionTimeoutMs: Hard cap of a /decisions call (SAP waits 3 s): after it the answer is 503 DECISION_TIMEOUT and SAP continues as NOT_CHECKED.
SapInterface._EventsLagLimitSeconds: data_delayed = true when the event feed lags more than this.
SapInterface._DefaultMode: Mode of the portal's Test decision (SAP always sends its own mode).
SapInterface._BlockVerdict: HOLD (spec v1.4: the tool's Block is sent as HOLD with reason_code BLOCK) or BLOCK (new verdict value, code B - a breaking change for SAP; only after the SAP side is ready).
SapInterface._UnknownItemPolicy: REJECT = 422 when any item cannot be decided (unknown article, no colour / delivery date); WATCH = such items get WATCH / CANNOT_VALIDATE and the rest is decided.
SapInterface._BmHead: bm_head_required rule hook (pending business rule): when Enabled, HOLD/BLOCK (and WATCH with IncludeWatch) of a PO whose net value >= MinNetValue also needs the B&M head (route_to BMHEAD).

_Kestrel: HTTPS for SAP on 8443 (spec section 2): rename _KestrelHttpsExample to Kestrel (or put it in appsettings.Production.json) with the company certificate. Kestrel then serves exactly these endpoints (launchSettings URLs are ignored). Off in Development.

Tool1._ReducedLabel: true = label proposals above Max Permissible (when it is > 0) as "Recommend Reduced Qty" (v1.1.4 README item 1). false = exactly as the running v1.1.4 page (Hold, then Auto Allow after confirming).

PoGovSettings._LoginMode: Hrms (default) = employees sign in with Employee ID + HRMS password; only employees the admin registered (Users -> Add employee, fetched from HRMS) can sign in, and HRMS is called only for them. Local = email + password kept by the tool (machines without HRMS access). HRMS URLs: API_MASTER rows HRP_GET_EMP_LOGIN_API / HRP_GET_EMP_DETAIL_CODE + API_BASE_URL HRMS_API (database/sqlserver/04_api_master.sql).
PoGovSettings._AllowAdminLocalLogin: Hrms mode: the built-in admin (AdminEmail) may still sign in with email + local password (first set-up, HRMS down). Set AdminEmpCode, sign in once with HRMS, then set this to false.
PoGovSettings._AdminEmpCode: Employee ID of the built-in admin: registered as an HRMS login at start-up.
PoGovSettings._HrmsPasswordUrl: Where employees change or unlock their HRMS password (sign-in page link).
